units.leftText: The LORD’s word that came to Joel, the son of Pethuel. Hear this, you elders,
units.rightText: This is the word of the LORD that came to Joel son of Pethuel: Hear this, O elders;

units.leftText: Tell your children about it, What the swarming locust has left, the great locust has eaten.
units.rightText: Tell it to your children; What the devouring locust has left,

units.leftText: Wake up, you drunkards, and weep! For a nation has come up on my land, strong, and without number.
units.rightText: Wake up, you drunkards, and weep; For a nation has invaded My land,

units.leftText: He has laid my vine waste, Mourn like a virgin dressed in sackcloth
units.rightText: It has laid waste My grapevine Wail like a virgin dressed in sackcloth,

units.leftText: The meal offering and the drink offering are cut off from the LORD’s house. The field is laid waste.
units.rightText: Grain and drink offerings have been cut off The field is ruined;

units.leftText: Be confounded, you farmers! The vine has dried up, and the fig tree withered—
units.rightText: Be dismayed, O farmers, The grapevine is dried up,

units.leftText: Put on sackcloth and mourn, you priests! Sanctify a fast.
units.rightText: Put on sackcloth and lament, O priests; Consecrate a fast;

units.leftText: Alas for the day! Isn’t the food cut off before our eyes,
units.rightText: Alas for the day! Has not the food been cut off

units.leftText: The seeds rot under their clods. How the animals groan!
units.rightText: The seeds lie shriveled beneath the clods; How the cattle groan!

units.leftText: LORD, I cry to you, Yes, the animals of the field pant to you,
units.rightText: To You, O LORD, I call, Even the beasts of the field pant for You,

units.leftText: Blow the trumpet in Zion, A day of darkness and gloominess,
units.rightText: Blow the ram’s horn in Zion; a day of darkness and gloom,

units.leftText: A fire devours before them, Their appearance is as the appearance of horses,
units.rightText: Before them a fire devours, Their appearance is like that of horses,

units.leftText: Like the noise of chariots on the tops of the mountains, they leap, At their presence the peoples are in anguish.
units.rightText: With a sound like that of chariots Nations writhe in horror before them;

units.leftText: They run like mighty men. One doesn’t jostle another.
units.rightText: They charge like mighty men; They do not jostle one another;

units.leftText: They rush on the city. The earth quakes before them.
units.rightText: They storm the city; Before them the earth quakes;

units.leftText: The LORD thunders his voice before his army, “Yet even now,” says the LORD, “turn to me with all your heart,
units.rightText: The LORD raises His voice “Yet even now,”

units.leftText: Tear your heart and not your garments, Who knows? He may turn and relent,
units.rightText: So rend your hearts and not your garments, Who knows? He may turn and relent

units.leftText: Blow the trumpet in Zion! Gather the people.
units.rightText: Blow the ram’s horn in Zion, Gather the people, sanctify the congregation,

units.leftText: Let the priests, the ministers of the LORD, weep between the porch and the altar, Then the LORD was jealous for his land,
units.rightText: Let the priests who minister before the LORD Then the LORD became jealous for His land,

units.leftText: The LORD answered his people, But I will remove the northern army far away from you,
units.rightText: And the LORD answered His people: The northern army I will drive away from you,

units.leftText: Land, don’t be afraid. Don’t be afraid, you animals of the field;
units.rightText: Do not be afraid, O land; Do not be afraid, O beasts of the field,

units.leftText: “Be glad then, you children of Zion, The threshing floors will be full of wheat,
units.rightText: Be glad, O children of Zion, The threshing floors will be full of grain,

units.leftText: I will restore to you the years that the swarming locust has eaten, You will have plenty to eat and be satisfied,
units.rightText: I will repay you for the years eaten by locusts — You will have plenty to eat,

units.leftText: You will know that I am among Israel, “It will happen afterward, that I will pour out my Spirit on all flesh;
units.rightText: Then you will know that I am present in Israel And afterward, I will pour out My Spirit on all people.

units.leftText: And also on the servants and on the handmaids in those days, I will show wonders in the heavens and on the earth:
units.rightText: Even on My menservants and maidservants, I will show wonders in the heavens and on the earth,

units.leftText: The sun will be turned into darkness, It will happen that whoever will call on the LORD’s name shall be saved;
units.rightText: The sun will be turned to darkness And everyone who calls on the name of the LORD

units.leftText: “For, behold, in those days, I will gather all nations,
units.rightText: “Yes, in those days and at that time, I will gather all the nations

units.leftText: and have cast lots for my people, “Yes, and what are you to me, Tyre and Sidon,
units.rightText: They cast lots for My people; Now what do you have against Me, O Tyre, Sidon, and all the regions of Philistia? Are you rendering against Me a recompense? If you retaliate against Me, I will swiftly and speedily return your recompense upon your heads.

units.leftText: Because you have taken my silver and my gold, and have sold the children of Judah and the children of Jerusalem to the sons of the Greeks,
units.rightText: For you took My silver and gold and carried off My finest treasures to your temples. You sold the people of Judah and Jerusalem to the Greeks, to send them far from their homeland.

units.leftText: Behold, I will stir them up out of the place where you have sold them, and I will sell your sons and your daughters into the hands of the children of Judah,
units.rightText: Behold, I will rouse them from the places to which you sold them; I will return your recompense upon your heads. I will sell your sons and daughters into the hands of the people of Judah, and they will sell them to the Sabeans — to a distant nation.”

units.leftText: Proclaim this among the nations: Beat your plowshares into swords,
units.rightText: Proclaim this among the nations: Beat your plowshares into swords

units.leftText: Hurry and come, all you surrounding nations, “Let the nations arouse themselves,
units.rightText: Come quickly, all you surrounding nations, Let the nations be roused

units.leftText: Put in the sickle; Multitudes, multitudes in the valley of decision!
units.rightText: Swing the sickle, Multitudes, multitudes

units.leftText: The sun and the moon are darkened, The LORD will roar from Zion,
units.rightText: The sun and moon will grow dark, The LORD will roar from Zion

units.leftText: “So you will know that I am the LORD, your God, It will happen in that day,
units.rightText: Then you will know that I am the LORD your God, And in that day the mountains will drip with sweet wine,

units.leftText: Egypt will be a desolation But Judah will be inhabited forever,
units.rightText: Egypt will become desolate, But Judah will be inhabited forever,
